title: GET /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/traffic: result
description: The traffic log's requests, newest first, as the Traffic logs page reads them. A row names the client that made the request.

enabled.description: Value. False where this installation keeps no traffic log; the list is then empty.

from.description: Value. The start of the window read, itself included: as asked, or an hour before to.

to.description: Value. The end of the window read, itself included: as asked, or now.

requests.description: The requests in the window, newest first.

time.description: Value. When the request was accepted.

node.description: Value. The node that served it.

request_number.description: Value. The node's own counter for the request.

host.description: Value. The Host the client asked for.

path.description: Value. The path and query the client asked for.

frontend.description: Value. HAProxy's frontend that took the request.

backend.description: Value. HAProxy's backend that served it.

server.description: Value. The server that answered, with its port.

status.description: Value. The HTTP status sent to the client.

request_time.description: Value. Milliseconds for the client to send the request; -1 where it never did.

queue_time.description: Value. Milliseconds in the queue; -1 where the request never queued.

connect_time.description: Value. Milliseconds to connect to the server; -1 where it never did.

response_time.description: Value. Milliseconds for the server's response; -1 where there was none.

total_time.description: Value. Milliseconds for the whole request.

bytes.description: Value. Bytes sent to the client.

rule.description: Value. The access rule the request met, as name:log or name:deny; empty where none.

rule_name.description: Value. The rule's name; empty where none.

rule_action.description: Code. What the rule did: denied the request, logged it, or empty where no rule applied.

termination.description: Code. HAProxy's termination state, two letters for who ended the session and where (-- normally); empty where not recorded. Its values are HAProxy's, not this API's.

ended.description: Text. The termination state in words; empty where the session ended normally. Match on termination instead.

truncated.description: Value. True where more requests match than were listed.

next.description: Value. Where the next page begins, to give as before; null where truncated is false. An opaque string: it names the last request listed, and the next page neither repeats a request nor drops one with the same time.

limit.description: Value. The most this answer lists, as asked or the default.

nodes.description: How fresh the log is, node by node.

last_attempt.description: Value. When the manager last tried to fetch the node's log; null where it never did.

last_success.description: Value. When it last succeeded; null where it never did.

outcome.description: Code. How the last attempt ended: ok, or what went wrong (ssh: the node did not answer, protocol, disk, budget: ran out of time, database), unknown where no record was kept.

catching_up.description: Value. True where the manager has not yet fetched everything the node holds, so the newest rows may be missing.
